name: Beaumont New Ammonia (Woodside), Texas
description: 1.1 Mt/yr ammonia plant at Beaumont, Texas, which produced first ammonia in December 2025 and came under Woodside's operational control in March 2026 after Woodside acquired OCI's clean-ammonia business; lower-carbon output is targeted for 2027.

source.note: Woodside Beaumont New Ammonia project page, read 2026-11-17

capacities.basis: reported 2023 direct emissions (metric tons CO2e, AR4 GWP); EPA facility ID 1010636. Reported as OCI Beaumont LLC (Nederland, TX); subparts C and X only, so the new ammonia train was not yet reporting in 2023.

source.note: EPA GHGRP 2023 data summary spreadsheets, direct point emitters, read 2026-11-17

capex.basis: consideration for OCI's clean-ammonia business including the Beaumont plant

source.note: OCI Global press release on completion of the clean-ammonia sale to Woodside, read 2026-11-17

sources.note: Woodside Beaumont New Ammonia project page (first ammonia December 2025, operational control March 2026, 1.1 Mt/yr, lower-carbon output 2027), read 2026-11-17
OCI Global press release on completion of the clean-ammonia sale to Woodside (consideration approximately USD 2,350 million), read 2026-11-17

notes: The adjacent Beaumont methanol plant (910,000 t/yr methanol and 340,000 t/yr ammonia) was sold by OCI to Methanex and closed on 27 June 2025; it is not part of this project.
